import pandas as pd
import csv
import os

# Read the input data
input_path = "outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Pivot the data: rows = city_id + year, columns = indicator_id, values = value
# Keep city_name as well
pivot_df = df.pivot_table(
    index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'],
    columns='indicator_id',
    values='value',
    aggfunc='first'
).reset_index()

# Sort by city_id and year for consistent ordering
pivot_df = pivot_df.sort_values(['city_id', 'year']).reset_index(drop=True)

# Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliance
output_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"

# Use pandas to_csv with quoting to handle RFC 4180
# quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL will quote fields containing the delimiter, quotechar, or newlines
with open(output_path, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    pivot_df.to_csv(f, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

print(f"Output written to {output_path}")
print(f"Shape: {pivot_df.shape}")
print(f"Columns: {list(pivot_df.columns)}")
</solution_file>
